scope: independent Node 24 SQLite preflight for C07/C08

checks.name: schema migration is idempotent
checks.detail: independent schema reopen and production desktop v1→v2 migration preserve the legacy reminder

checks.name: account partition prevents cross-account reads
checks.detail: same reminder id is stored independently per account

checks.name: same schedule is idempotent
checks.detail: replaying the same version does not duplicate the row

checks.name: older version is rejected
checks.detail: a lower schedule version cannot overwrite a newer row

checks.name: same version conflict is rejected
checks.detail: same version with different content is not silently merged

checks.name: cancelled reminder does not submit when due
checks.detail: cancelled rows remain cancelled at the due time

checks.name: submitted status survives close and reopen
checks.detail: independent reopen plus production account, instance/version, monotonic receipt, and failure terminal checks passed

limitations: This runs Node 24 node:sqlite fixtures and the production desktop store module without launching Electron; it is not a system-device or Electron runtime verification.
No Android Room, notification permission, AlarmManager/WorkManager, Windows encryption key storage or system notification was tested.
No force-stop, sleep, reboot, desktop toast, user-visible receipt or real background delivery was tested.
Database files are temporary and removed after the preflight completes.
